source: Official TfL Unified API arrivals, line and stop metadata, and byte-identical official physical station archive. Empty cable-car responses do not establish unsupported capability.
mappingRule: Tram requires a unique exact service line + stop area + published platform number (including empty string) + explicit cardinal direction. Exact Eastbound Platform and Westbound Platform labels retain empty numbers. Numbered live labels never match blank published numbers, and a direction-only label never matches a numbered platform. Destinations, API inbound/outbound, branches and historical platform IDs are not used.

cableCarReview.reason: Official line metadata identifies London Cable Car, but line-wide and both exact-stop arrivals returned empty arrays. No reviewed prediction or official unsupported declaration establishes live-feed capability or physical matching. Retain both physical records browse-only.
